solution: MEET AT THE OLD OBSERVATORY. BRING THE BRASS COMPASS. WAIT UNTIL THE MORNING BELLS RING.
ciphertext: TLLA HA AOL VSK VIZLYCHAVYF. IYPUN AOL IYHZZ JVTWHZZ. DHPA BUAPS AOL TVYUPUN ILSSZ YPUN.
ending: The note points to the old observatory at dawn. You pocket the brass compass and head for the hill. When the morning bells ring, you will be ready.
title: The Observatory Note
briefing: The astronomer has vanished. A note left beside her telescope is your only lead. Decode it to discover where to go and what to bring.
clues: AOL appears 3 times as a complete three-letter word. THE is a useful word to try. A is the most frequent cipher letter (8 appearances).
This note uses a Caesar cipher: the whole alphabet moved by the same number of places. If AOL means THE, each pair must follow the same shift.
A stands for T, O stands for H, and L stands for E. The encryption shift is 7. Use that pattern to work out the remaining letters.

firstMove.description: AOL appears three times. It could mean THE. Try that guess and watch the note change.
